items.example: I hate doing chores on Sunday.
items.exampleTr: Pazar günü ev işi yapmaktan nefret ediyorum.
items.simple: A job you must do at home. It is not fun, but you do it.

items.example: We share the housework.
items.simple: All the jobs you do in your home, like cleaning.

items.example: I have a lot of laundry to do.
items.simple: Dirty clothes that you must wash.

items.example: I do the laundry every Saturday.
items.simple: You put dirty clothes in a machine with water and soap.
items.note: 'wash the clothes' da denir ama 'do the laundry' daha doğal.

items.example: There's too much rubbish in the kitchen.
items.simple: Things you do not want anymore, like old paper and food.

items.example: Can you take out the rubbish, please?
items.simple: You put the old things you do not want in a big box outside.

items.example: Put it in the bin.
items.simple: A big box where you put things you do not want.

items.example: My room is always tidy.
items.simple: Everything is in its place. Nothing is on the floor.

items.example: Let's tidy up before the guests arrive.
items.simple: You put things back in the right place so the room is nice.

items.example: I vacuum the living room twice a week.
items.simple: You clean the floor with a machine that sucks up dirt.

items.example: Can you sweep the floor?
items.simple: You use a long brush to move dirt off the floor.

items.example: I need to mop the kitchen floor.
items.simple: You clean the floor with a wet cloth on a long stick.

items.example: I dust the shelves every week.
items.simple: You take the little dirty bits off a table or shelf.

items.example: I have to iron my shirt for tomorrow.
items.simple: You make clothes flat and nice with a hot flat tool.

items.example: Could you fold the clean clothes?
items.simple: You make clothes flat and small, one on top of the other.

items.example: I'll do the washing-up after dinner.
items.simple: You clean plates and cups with water and soap after you eat.

items.example: Put the plates in the dishwasher.
items.simple: A big machine that cleans plates and cups for you.

items.example: I make the bed every morning.
items.simple: You fix your sheets and pillow so your bed looks nice.

items.example: I did it yesterday. It's your turn today.
items.exampleTr: Dün ben yaptım. Bugün sıra sende.
items.simple: Now it is your time to do it. The one before you did it.

items.en: Can you give me a hand?
items.example: Can you give me a hand with the shopping bags?
items.exampleTr: Alışveriş poşetlerinde bana yardım eder misin?
items.simple: You ask someone to help you with a job.

items.example: I cooked, so you can wash up.
items.exampleTr: Ben yemek yaptım, bulaşığı sen yıka.
items.simple: You clean the plates and cups after eating.
items.note: Amerika'da 'wash up' el yüz yıkamak demektir.

items.en: I need to + verb: I need to clean the bathroom.
items.example: I need to clean the bathroom today.
items.simple: You must do this. You say it when a job is waiting.
